const p = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Interactive RCB limited-mode controller for the measuring-spoon episode.
+
+Commands arrive as JSON lines on stdin.  This keeps one Robot client alive
+while allowing each observation and action to be chosen from the live scene.
+"""
+import json
+import pathlib
+import sys
+
+import numpy as np
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+
+OUT = pathlib.Path("/app/output")
+RUNS = pathlib.Path("/app/runs")
+OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+RUNS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+r = Robot()
+spec = r.spec()
+(OUT / "spec.json").write_text(json.dumps(spec, indent=2))
+print(json.dumps({"ready": True, "protocol": spec.get("protocol"), "budget": spec.get("budget")}), flush=True)
+
+
+def pack_result(res, name):
+    path = RUNS / name
+    res.save(str(path))
+    return {"path": str(path), "meta": res.meta,
+            "cameras": list(res.last), "video_cameras": list(res.video),
+            "frame_counts": {k: len(v) for k, v in res.frames.items()},
+            "depth_cameras": list(res.last_depth) + list(res.depth)}
+
+
+for line in sys.stdin:
+    try:
+        cmd = json.loads(line)
+        op = cmd["op"]
+        if op == "obs":
+            res = r.get_obs(cameras=cmd.get("cameras"), seconds=cmd.get("seconds", 0),
+                            video=cmd.get("video", "frames"), video_fps=cmd.get("video_fps"),
+                            depth=cmd.get("depth"))
+            result = pack_result(res, cmd.get("name", "obs"))
+            result["proprio"] = res.meta.get("proprio")
+        elif op == "submit":
+            res = r.submit(cmd["type"], cmd["actions"], dt=cmd.get("dt"),
+                           cameras=cmd.get("cameras"), video_fps=cmd.get("video_fps"),
+                           video=cmd.get("video", "frames"), depth=cmd.get("depth"), note=cmd.get("note", ""))
+            result = pack_result(res, cmd.get("name", "action"))
+            result["proprio_last"] = None if res.proprio is None else res.proprio[-1].tolist()
+        elif op == "status":
+            result = r.status()
+        elif op == "spec":
+            result = spec
+        elif op == "fk":
+            result = r.fk(cmd["q"], links=cmd.get("links"))
+        elif op == "ik":
+            result = r.ik(cmd["targets"], seed=cmd.get("seed"), **cmd.get("opts", {}))
+        elif op == "quit":
+            print(json.dumps({"ok": True}), flush=True)
+            break
+        else:
+            raise ValueError(f"unknown op {op}")
+        print(json.dumps(result), flush=True)
+    except Exception as exc:
+        print(json.dumps({"error": type(exc).__name__, "detail": str(exc)}), flush=True)
*** End Patch";
const r = await tools.apply_patch(p);
text(r);
